context: This image is an isolated SDF Modeler kit-asset view: one candy-world obstacle rendered alone on a plain neutral studio backdrop, as the project's view spec requires, not a gameplay screenshot. The course, characters, environment, sky and bloom of the reference are absent by design. Grade the piece only, against the matching piece of the reference: glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue look, white zigzags or candy stripes, chunky rounded rims and toy-like proportions.

views.description: candy.pendulum-hammer, the inflatable hammer of ref-1: a fat glossy pink drum-shaped head lying along X with chunky rounded yellow rims and blue end faces, a white zigzag band printed around its middle, on a blue inflatable arm with yellow collars rising to a yellow pivot hub on a pink axle, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.spinner-bar, the rotating spinner bar of ref-1: a long fat glossy pink inflatable tube with white helical candy stripes, chunky rounded yellow end caps and yellow collars, on a rounded pink hub cap over a yellow post and a blue base with a yellow rim, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/white inflatable style. Camera: the project's front three-quarter view (camera on +X+Z at yaw 45 degrees); the view spec raises the eye by only a quarter of the piece's height, so this long, low bar is seen almost at eye level: its near (+X) end is larger in perspective, and the base shows as a band under the hub rather than from above; in ref-1's glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue style with white zigzags and chunky rounded rims

candy.floor-tile, a square floor tile of ref-1's floating platforms: a thick glossy candy slab with a light-blue walkable top quilted into four puffy domed cushions (2 x 2, with soft creased seams between them), a chunky rounded yellow inflatable bolster rim around the top edge, a pink side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded yellow bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The quilted cushions sit inside the fat rounded inflatable bolster rim, like ref-1's padded inflatable floor mats, and under that rim the side band shows its bold white zigzag between the top and bottom rims

candy.floor-disc, a round floor disc of ref-1's floating platforms: a thick glossy candy disc with a pink walkable top cushion carrying a white ring and centre dot target, a chunky rounded yellow inflatable rim around the top edge, a blue side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded yellow bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The walkable top is a gently domed cushion set inside the fat rounded inflatable bolster rim, like an inflatable mat, and under that rim the side band shows its bold white zigzag between the top and bottom rims

candy.moving-platform, a small square floating platform of ref-1: a thick glossy candy slab with a yellow walkable top cushion, a chunky rounded pink inflatable rim around the top edge, a blue side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded pink bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The walkable top is a gently domed cushion set inside the fat rounded inflatable bolster rim, like an inflatable mat, and under that rim the side band shows its bold white zigzag between the top and bottom rims

candy.bounce-pad, the bounce pad of ref-1: a squat glossy inflatable drum with a chunky rounded blue rim wrapped by a white piped zigzag trim all around, topped by a springy glossy pink dome with a yellow ring and a yellow centre disc carrying a white six-point star mark, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.conveyor-belt, a candy conveyor belt in ref-1's style: a long, low glossy pink inflatable slab with rounded edges, a yellow lip and pink belt top with white chevron stripes pointing along +Z (toward the left end, which has a rounded blue roller cap), in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly); in ref-1's glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue style with white zigzags and chunky rounded rims

candy.finish-arch, the crown arch at the finish of ref-1: a big glossy inflatable arch with two chunky round posts (one pink with a blue band, one blue with a pink band) ringed by rounded yellow rims and standing on yellow bases, a chunky rounded yellow beam across the top with a pink band printed with a bold white zigzag, and a yellow crown on top whose points carry pink and blue jewel balls, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.checkpoint-gate, a smaller checkpoint arch of the same candy family as ref-1's crown arch: two chunky round inflatable posts (one pink with a blue band, one blue with a pink band) ringed by rounded yellow rims on yellow bases, a rounded yellow beam across the top with a pink band printed with a bold white zigzag, and a small pink pennant flag on a short white pole at the centre of the beam, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.rotating-door, a rotating door obstacle like ref-1's inflatable obstacles: two crossed glossy inflatable panels, one pink and one blue, each framed by chunky rounded yellow inflatable edges and printed with a bold white zigzag, turning on a central yellow hub with pink and blue rings and a pink ball on top, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The two panels cross at the central hub at right angles (the hub is at their meeting point); from the 45 degree view the two panels project as two wings of an X-like arrangement around the hub, so they can look nearly side by side, and the white zigzags read slightly pale on the shaded panel; judge the parts, colours and glossy inflatable finish; in ref-1's glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue style with white zigzags and chunky rounded rims

candy.seesaw-plank, a see-saw plank like ref-1's inflatable platforms: a long rounded glossy yellow plank framed by puffy pink inflatable rims on all four sides, with a bold white zigzag running along its top and a blue round fulcrum with yellow end caps under its middle, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The plank is low, long and shown at a shallow angle: its blue fulcrum (a cylinder across the plank width with yellow end caps) sits under the middle of the plank, so in this view only the near end cap and a sliver of blue show below the rim, and the far end is hidden behind the plank; this is correct. The finish is the same smooth glossy inflatable shading as the rest of the kit, with a bright highlight along the pink rims

candy.wall-block, a padded wall like ref-1's inflatable walls: a long puffy wall made of five rounded inflatable cushions alternating blue and pink, sitting on a rounded yellow base under a rounded yellow top rail, with a white zigzag trim running along both faces, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). Only the near (+Z) face and the +X end are visible in this view, so the zigzag trim is judged on the visible face only; the zigzag is white, slightly shaded in the lower light

candy.queue-pad, a round hub queue pad like ref-1's round candy pads: a low glossy pink cushion top sitting in a chunky rounded yellow inflatable rim with a white zigzag edge around its side, four white L-shaped corner brackets on the pink top framing a white ring with a blue centre dot (a queue-pad target marking, not arrows), in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.plaza-fountain, a plaza fountain in ref-1's inflatable candy look: a round pink basin on a yellow foot with a chunky rounded yellow rim and a white zigzag band around its side, filled with a glossy bright green slime surface, and a central tiered pink column with a yellow dish holding blue water, a smaller pink dish with blue water, and a yellow ball with a small blue water drop on top, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.podium-block, a podium block like ref-1's padded inflatable blocks: a square padded pink block with chunky rounded yellow rims at its top and bottom edges, a puffy blue cushion on top, and a bold white zigzag trim running around all four sides, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.slime-pool, a glossy green slime surface like the bright green bubbly slime below the track in ref-1: a wide flat square pool of glossy lime-green slime whose surface is a gently waving field of rounded slime bubbles (like ref-1's bubble-wrap slime), each with a small white glossy highlight, plus scattered round white bubbles and longer white highlight streaks, framed by a chunky rounded pink inflatable tube rim on all four sides with white candy-stripe bands, glossy yellow ball knobs at the four corners and a thin yellow base lip, in ref-1's glossy candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The pool is a large low piece (12 x 12 m, about 1 m tall at its corner knobs), so it appears as a flat diamond-shaped surface in this view; this is correct; in ref-1's glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue style with white zigzags and chunky rounded rims

candy.cloud, a puffy white cloud like the soft cumulus clouds in ref-1's sky: a wide cartoon cloud made of many merged round white puffs, larger puffs piled on top of a flatter base, about twice as wide as it is tall, with a soft matte white finish, in ref-1's toy-like candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). It is shown alone on the studio backdrop without the sky, so only its puffy white silhouette and soft shading are judged; in ref-1's glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue style with white zigzags and chunky rounded rims

candy.banner, a crown banner like the tall blue banners lining the track in ref-1: a 4 m pole with pink and white candy stripes on a round pink base with a yellow collar, a glossy yellow ball on top, and a T-shaped yellow crossbar with round yellow end knobs from which a tall blue flag hangs, framed by chunky rounded pink top and bottom hems; the flag carries a yellow crown in its upper part and a yellow diagonal band across its lower part with a small orange corner, like ref-1's banners, in ref-1's glossy toy-like candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The flag is a flat printed pennant, not an inflatable. It is shown alone on the studio backdrop, without the course or sky

candy.hot-air-balloon, a hot-air balloon like the one floating in ref-1's sky: a round, slightly teardrop envelope with vertical pink, yellow, blue and white stripes meeting at a yellow top cap, with a small orange basket with a pink rim hanging below on thin ropes, about 6 m tall, in ref-1's glossy toy-like candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). It is shown alone on the studio backdrop, without the course or sky

candy.tower, a background castle tower like the purple towers behind the track in ref-1: a tall 14 m purple cylindrical tower on a chunky yellow plinth, ringed by thick yellow trim bands, a chunky yellow collar with yellow ball studs, small blue windows, and a rounded glossy pink dome roof with a yellow ball finial, in ref-1's glossy toy-like candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). It is shown alone on the studio backdrop, without the course or sky
